Who we are

ABOUT 5 AAB IMMIGRATION

5 AAB Immigration, led by Ajaydeep Singh, is here to help individuals and families plan their international journey. We provide guidance on visa pathways, application steps and document preparation, with a focus on clear communication and personalised support.

We encourage every applicant to verify eligibility, fees and current requirements with the relevant government or official authority before making decisions.

✓ Your goals matter
